provenance.source: Chinese Wikipedia 2023-07-20 dump, filtered and script-converted by dataset provider; not an independent truth audit.
provenance.scope: Candidate text only, not selected by any training plan. Preserve attribution and original source notice; no model weights downloaded.

findings: Some mathematical entries lost formulas and are unusable without filtering.
Some entries contain raw thumb markers and citation-number remnants.
Article URLs and explicit titles are not preserved as separate fields; attribution must retain original collection and source notices.
Many entries concern specific people, places and historical facts; broad prose is not a replacement for grounded multi-turn instruction data.
Snapshot content may be dated; not a live facts source.
decision: Do not insert into active capacity comparison. Any later use requires formatting/length filtering, held overlap audit and explicit new plan; keep source metadata and avoid treating third-party descriptions as individual experiences.
